    • getPrieteniOnPage

      public Page<Utilizator> getPrieteniOnPage(Long userId, int pageNumber, int pageSize)
      Retrieves a paginated slice of friends for a given user.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose friends are requested
      pageNumber - zero-based page index (must be >=0
      pageSize - number of elements per page (must be >0
      Returns:
      a Page of Utilizator representing the user's friends
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if userId does not exist or pagination params are invalid
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the configured repository does not support pagination
